name: poker
description: poker.imre.dev — a no-auth, realtime voting room app

scripts.dev: PM2_HOME=.pm2 pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs && PM2_HOME=.pm2 pm2 logs poker --raw
scripts.dev:stop: PM2_HOME=.pm2 pm2 stop poker && PM2_HOME=.pm2 pm2 delete poker
scripts.dev:systemd:install: cp systemd/poker.service ~/.config/systemd/user/poker.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now poker
scripts.dev:systemd:uninstall: systemctl --user disable --now poker && rm -f ~/.config/systemd/user/poker.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload
scripts.dev:cloudflare:uninstall: systemctl --user disable --now cloudflared && rm -f ~/.config/systemd/user/cloudflared.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload
